payload.text: hv, 2026-10-24 about 19:3xZ, answered in vc's session (TUI), after CI's Ubuntu job went red on v0.1.14 (run 40121933255; 0222, rustup's home under 0213's per-arm HOME): CI GREEN BEFORE THE CUT. hv pushes main first, and the release pre-flight refuses unless CI's run on that exact commit is green, so a Linux-only defect is caught before any tag (0223). Chosen over a Linux suite on kovacs at each landing, both, or the fix with no gate. 0222 and 0223 go into 0.1.15. Not put to hv again.
